name: versionbar-workspace
description: Root task runner for the VersionBar monorepo. The product name and version live in core/pyproject.toml.

scripts.test: npm run test:core && npm run test:repo && npm run test:ui && npm run test:rust
scripts.test:core: uv run --project core --group dev pytest core
scripts.lint: npm run lint:core && npm run lint:repo && npm run lint:versions && npm run lint:gen && npm run lint:ui && npm run lint:rust
scripts.lint:core: uv run --project core --group dev ruff check core && uv run --project core --group dev ruff format --check core && uv run --project core --group dev ty check --project core
scripts.lint:repo: uvx taplo==0.9.3 check && uvx taplo==0.9.3 fmt --check && uvx --from actionlint-py==1.7.12.24 actionlint
scripts.lint:rust: cargo fmt --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings && cargo deny --manifest-path app/src-tauri/Cargo.toml check
